member.name: T:System.Windows.Forms.AutoClosingMessageBox
member.summary: An IMessageBox implementation that wraps a platform message box and automatically disposes it after a timeout. This class delegates actual presentation to a non-static MessageBox implementation and starts a background task to auto-close/cleanup the underlying GTK after milliseconds.
